commit_clusters.8087ee1b38b0: insn-tablegen (RISCVInstrInfoXpulp.td; the task named codegen-core but the patterns live in the insn-tablegen file, so the fixup targets that cluster)

root_cause: RISCVInstrInfoXpulp.td selected (and (vector_extract v4i8/v2i16, uimm6), 255/65535), which is a zero-extended lane, as the sign-extending PV_EXTRACT_B/H. Fixed by selecting PV_EXTRACTU_B/H (2-line change). Pre-existing since fork commit f1b7aebff8c2 '[LLVM/PULP/SNITCH] Support for PULP and Snitch cores/platforms'. The variable-index path (pv.shuffle + p.extbz/p.exthz) and the sext_inreg/anyext patterns were already correct, so zext/sext/anyext of an extract now all match the DAG, for both element sizes and for split wider vectors.
upstream_reference: llvmorg-20.1.8 RISCVInstrInfoXCV.td:427-430 (cv.extract/cv.extractu.{h,b}) and :792-795 (sext_inreg -> sign-extending, and 0xff/0xffff -> CV_EXTBZ/CV_EXTHZ). GAP9 GCC also emits pv.extractu.b/.h for unsigned lanes. Encodings of pv.extractu.b/.h are the same in llvm-mc and the GAP9 GCC assembler.
